name: deferred-recall-strict
description: Same conversation as deferred-recall, plus two checks on turn 2: the NPC recalls the debt the player stated on turn 1 (replyMatches owe|debt|forty crowns, so any phrasing of the debt counts), and does not deny ever having met or spoken with the player. This is the ERR-030 gate; see research/09-npc-runtime/BASELINE.md for the before/after numbers. Live models are stochastic, so read passRate per check across trials, not only passK.

definition.name: Mira
definition.description: A harbourmaster who keeps ledgers and grudges.

core_anchor.backstory: Mira has run the harbour office for twenty years and remembers every debt.

script: My brother Kael owes you forty crowns.
Do you remember what I told you about my brother?

events.text: A storm warning was posted at the harbour gate.
